semantics.counts: all SCSI attempts; READ/WRITE bytes only on success
semantics.command_ticks: whole ufs_scsi_impl including descriptor/DMA/cache work, excludes caller mutex wait and strategy bounce memcpy
semantics.doorbell_ticks: immediately before doorbell write until completion observed/timeout, includes polling/scheduling
semantics.link: six local DME_GET; no tuning; validity mask mandatory
semantics.recovery: pending UIC completion+READY drained before controller handoff; no UIC abort/reset
